context: A teacher and a uni student discuss a research project's aims
purpose: Teach: 主旨/担い/抱え/仕方/推進/占める/認知/自社

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: それで、君の研究プロジェクトの主旨はもう固まったかな？
lines.en: So, has the main aim of your research project been settled yet?
lines.style: Warm but probing, classic mentor tone inviting clarification.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、地方の若者が地域づくりをどう担いたいと思っているか、その意識を調べたいんです。
lines.en: Yes, I want to investigate how rural youth feel about taking on the role of community building.
lines.style: Earnest student voice, slightly nervous but clearly prepared.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: なるほど。実は私もその分野には強い関心を持っていてね、面白いテーマだと思うわ。
lines.en: I see. Actually, I have a strong interest in that field myself, and I find it a fascinating topic.
lines.style: Encouraging teacher, sharing personal stake with measured warmth.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ただ、調査範囲が広すぎるという悩みを抱えていまして、仕方なく今は三県に限定しています。
lines.en: However, I'm carrying the worry that the survey scope is too broad, so reluctantly I've limited it to three prefectures for now.
lines.style: Honest confession, mildly frustrated but seeking guidance respectfully.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: それで構わない。むしろ地域推進政策との関連を一つの軸にすると、論点が明確になるはずよ。
lines.en: That's perfectly fine. Rather, if you make the link to regional promotion policy one of your axes, your argument will become clearer.
lines.style: Decisive academic advice, redirecting toward a sharper analytical frame.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 確かに。地元の自社ブランド農産物が地域経済に占める割合も気になっていて、そこと絡められそうです。
lines.en: Indeed. I've also been curious about the share that locally-owned brand produce occupies in the regional economy, and I think I could tie it in there.
lines.style: Sudden burst of confidence, ideas connecting in real time.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 良い視点ね。若者の地元に対する認知や愛着も、忘れずに変数に入れておきなさい。
lines.en: That's a good perspective. Don't forget to include young people's recognition of and attachment to their hometown as variables too.
lines.style: Practical scholarly nudge, ensuring methodological completeness with care.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、来週までに調査設計の改訂版をお持ちします。本当にありがとうございます。
lines.en: Yes, I'll bring you a revised version of the research design by next week. Thank you very much.
lines.style: Grateful and resolved, ending with respectful student formality.
